projects.title: AR Autopilot: AI Workflow Automation

projects.title: Retail Margin Cockpit
projects.description: A governed margin and inventory source of truth for retail teams: a dbt star schema, a DAX measure library, and a Power BI report with row-level security by region, replacing five disconnected spreadsheets.

projects.title: Field Ops Cost-to-Serve Audit
projects.description: A tested dbt and SQL pipeline that reconciles dispatch, route, timesheet, and fuel data into a true cost-to-serve per job and route, and shows where SLA breaches concentrate.

projects.title: cohortkit
projects.description: A Python library and CLI that produces cohort retention triangles, RFM segments, and revenue by cohort from any orders table, running in-process on DuckDB with no warehouse to set up.

projects.title: Snowflake, dbt, and Tableau Pipeline
projects.description: Moves sales data from AWS S3 into Snowflake, transforms it into a star schema with dbt, and serves a live Tableau dashboard, with the pipeline automated through GitHub Actions.

projects.title: SQL Data Warehouse
projects.description: A SQL Server warehouse with bronze, silver, and gold layers that ingests ERP and CRM extracts, cleans and standardizes them, and models a star schema for sales reporting.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.description: Statistical tests identify what drives churn at a telecom provider, then a classification model predicts which customers are likely to leave, with retention recommendations and predictions delivered as a CSV.

projects.title: HR and Compensation Analytics
projects.description: A people analytics data model examining attrition, compensation, performance, and satisfaction, using a normalized MySQL schema with a denormalized MongoDB analytical layer to find which pay bands and performance tiers carry the most turnover risk.

projects.title: Supply Chain Analysis for AtliQ Mart
projects.description: A Power BI data model and report tracking on-time, in-full, and OTIF delivery for an FMCG manufacturer whose key customers were not renewing contracts over service issues.

projects.title: Log Analysis and Anomaly Detection
projects.description: Parses logs from files or live network streams, extracts features, and flags unusual activity with an Isolation Forest to surface potential security threats as they happen.

projects.title: Predictive Maintenance
projects.description: Uses sensor readings such as temperature, voltage, and pressure to detect when equipment behaves abnormally and forecast failures before they cause unscheduled downtime.

projects.title: Employee Attrition Prediction
projects.description: Models attrition on the IBM HR dataset to find the strongest drivers of turnover and identify which employees are most at risk of leaving, and why.

projects.title: Analytics Engineering Prototype
projects.description: A dimensional model for a specialty-food import-export company, built with dbt on BigQuery to move reporting off an overloaded operational database.

projects.title: Financial Insights in Banking Data

projects.title: Customer Behavior Analysis
projects.description: An end-to-end analysis of retail customer data: preparation in Python, querying in SQL, and a Power BI report on purchasing behavior and customer segments.

projects.title: Sales Insights for a Hardware Company
projects.description: SQL ETL into a star schema and a Tableau dashboard analyzing year-on-year sales performance for an India-based computer hardware company.

projects.title: BCG X Data Science Job Simulation (Forage)
